page: Microsoft Azure DC4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

This server includes 154 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any graphics processing units, meaning all workloads rely entirely on the dedicated CPU cores. Additionally, the configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the DC4ads_v6 offers a predictable resource profile for general-purpose workloads. The inclusion of local SSD storage provides a qualitative advantage for applications requiring low-latency scratch space. This hardware configuration is suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, and small database workloads that benefit from dedicated compute resources and local SSD storage.
